title: Content contract
description: The shape of GET /api/site.json and of site.content in the host API (docs/frontend-protocol.md, 'Content contract'). Front ends depend on this, never on the CMS schema. Evolution is additive only: never remove or retype a property, never make a property newly required (new fields are optional here even though the server always sends them). internal/contract's compatibility test enforces this against content-contract.v<contractVersion>.snapshot.json.

contractVersion.description: Major version of this contract. Changes only with a breaking change.

pages.description: Published CMS pages, ordered by slug (home first). Keyed by slug.

experiments.description: Published experiments, in their CMS order. Keyed by slug.

slug.description: The page's path without slashes; "" is the home page.

body.description: Plain text; paragraphs separated by blank lines. May be "".

generated.description: Names of this item's fields whose values were generated by the site observer rather than written by a person.

extra.description: An extra field (usually observer-generated, then listed in _generated). Front ends must read extra fields with site.field and a fallback.
